articles.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt
articles.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

articles.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
articles.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

articles.title: Stripe backer Atomico calls for Europe to own its success stories

articles.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
articles.summary: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.

articles.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
articles.summary: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.

articles.title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
articles.summary: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.

articles.title: Waymo suspends freeway rides nationwide after California DMV order
articles.summary: The DMV said Waymo's freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety.  Restrictions will remain in place until Waymo can demonstrate that it has taken "effective corrective actions" to address the deficiencies.

articles.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work

articles.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
